brief: Two pairs of bases. Bolt the two bases of each pair together, with no connector inside a pair. Put the pairs side by side and fit a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other.

requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases (four bases total)
requirements.evidence: Four full bases at 0,0 / 0,1 (pair one) and 1,0 / 1,1 (pair two) on level 0; check_build topology confirms two groups [[0,0,0,1],[1,0,1,1]].

requirements.requirement: The two bases of each pair bolted together
requirements.evidence: Joint bolts jointBolt:0#0,0#0 on wall 0,0|0,1 and jointBolt:0#0,1#0 on wall 1... in-pair walls 0,0|0,1 and 1,0|1,1 are bolted (further bolts jointBolt:0#0,0#5 / 0#1,0#5 added by lockJoints sit on cross-pair walls, not inside a pair).
Topology lists in-pair walls 0,0|0,1 and 1,0|1,1 as 'bare' for connector purposes — no connector refs on them; the three connector refs are all on cross-pair edges.
Pair 1(0,*) and pair 2 (1,*) are adjacent in a 2x2 block, sharing walls 0,0|1,0, 0,1|1,0 (diagonal) and 0,1|1,1.

requirements.requirement: A side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other
requirements.evidence: Side connectors connector:0#0,0|1,0, connector:0#0,1|1,0 and connector:0#0,1|1,1 cover all three cross-pair walls; check_build topology shows each marked 'connector'.

requirements.requirement: House rules: cap open faces and lock joints
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 14 solid caps; lockJoints added bolts. check_build ok, meshClash clear, no issues.

finish.summary: Four full bases in a 2x2 block form two pairs: (0,0)+(0,1) and (1,0)+(1,1). Each pair is bolted together with a joint bolt on its shared wall, and no connector sits inside either pair. The pairs touch along three walls (0,0|1,0, 0,1|1,0 diagonal, 0,1|1,1), and each of those carries a side connector, so the checker's topology shows exactly two groups joined by connectors. Open faces are capped and joints locked; check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
